body: Boeing reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $24.2 billion, up 4 percent from a year earlier, and a net loss of $116 million, narrowing sharply from a $5.3 billion loss in the same quarter of 2025. GAAP loss per share was $0.26, compared with $7.14 a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $1.5 billion and free cash flow was $0.5 billion, while total company backlog grew to a record $745 billion, including more than 6,300 commercial airplanes.

In commercial airplanes, the 737-7 received amended type certification from the FAA during the quarter and the 737-10 received certification in October. The division delivered 161 airplanes in the quarter, booked 300 net orders, and ended with a commercial backlog valued at a record $612 billion. Boeing also said it was selected by the U.S. Navy to design, build and deliver the F/A-XX next-generation fighter aircraft, although that order is not yet included in backlog pending completion of the source selection and evaluation review process.

Defense, Space & Security revenue rose 15 percent to $7.9 billion, with operating earnings of $492 million that included a $252 million gain on the sale of HRL Laboratories, while Global Services revenue rose 4 percent to $5.6 billion. Boeing president and chief executive Kelly Ortberg described the 737-7 and 737-10 certifications and the Navy fighter selection as important steps, while noting the company remains focused on safety and quality and on disciplined execution.
en.summary: Boeing's third-quarter revenue rose 4 percent to $24.2 billion and its net loss narrowed to $116 million, as total backlog reached a record $745 billion and both remaining 737 MAX variants gained certification.
en.title: Boeing Q3 revenue rises to $24.2 billion, loss narrows, backlog hits record $745 billion

body: 波音公布2026年第三季營收242億美元、較去年同期成長4%，淨虧損1.16億美元、較去年同期53億美元虧損大幅收斂，每股虧損0.26美元。第三季營運現金流15億美元、自由現金流5億美元，季末公司整體積壓訂單創下7450億美元新高，其中商用飛機超過6300架。
商用飛機方面，737-7已在本季取得美國聯邦航空總署修訂型號認證，737-10於10月取得認證；本季交付161架飛機、新增淨訂單300架，商用飛機積壓訂單價值創下6120億美元新高。波音同時獲美國海軍選定設計、建造與交付F/A-XX下一代戰機，但該訂單在來源評選與評估審查完成前尚未列入積壓訂單。
國防、太空與安全部門營收年增15%至79億美元，全球服務部門營收年增4%至56億美元。波音總裁暨執行長凱利·歐特柏格表示，737-7與737-10取得認證及海軍戰機獲選是重要進展，公司仍將專注於安全與品質並以嚴謹執行兌現承諾。
